newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile electricity prices to fall five pct -- gov't.
newsitem.headline: Chile electricity prices to fall five pct -- gov't.

text.p: Chilean electricity distribution prices will fall by an average five percent with the new rates coming into force June 28, said Energy Minister Alejandro Jadresic.
"The imapct will be proportionally greater for residential clients, especially in urban areas with overhead cables," Jadresic told a news conference.
Domestic customers will see their electricity bills fall by eight percent, while industrial clients will have reductions of up to four percent, he said.
The new rates will be in force until October 2000 and will be retroactive to November 1996 when they were originally due to come into force.

The government was forced to delay the new rate structure by a lawsuit brought by four companies that objected to the method officials used to set the new rates. ((-- Paulina Modiano, Santiago newsroom, 562-699-5595 x212))
